title: Core: AS2 comparison operators (<, >, <=, >=)
description: Test compilation of comparison operators: a < b (ActionLess2 0x48), a > b (ActionGreater 0x67), a <= b (ActionGreater + ActionNot), a >= b (ActionLess2 + ActionNot). Test with strings: 'a' < 'b'. Test with mixed types. Test chained comparisons: 0 < x && x < 10. Verify each emits the correct AVM1 opcode.
